about: VOS's conformance vectors G1–G17 for Kreivo's spaces pallet (docs/design/spaces-pallet.md v2, §10), generated by VOS's reference mock (node/venue/src/kreivo) over the kit's golden fixtures; regenerate them in VOS (`just conformance`), never by hand. The mock judges registrations and anchors by vos_anchor::venue, as the pallet is asked to.

A vector: the constants (above), a pre-state and steps. The pre-state: now_ms (Timestamp.Now), each account's free and held balances (HoldReason Registration and Submit) and its providers and consumers, and the pallet's raw storage (key → SCALE value, hex). The venue (frame_system::block_hash(0)) is constants.venue. MaxRootAge and the window lengths a venue registers are vos_anchor's constants (MAX_ROOT_AGE_MS, MIN_LENGTH_MS, MAX_LENGTH_MS).

A step: now_ms, then a call (origin: {"signed": account} or root, programs (ProgramsOrigin), emergency (EmergencyOrigin), status (StatusOrigin); call: the RuntimeCall's bytes, [90, call_index] ++ SCALE(args), as parts: hex, or {fixture, from, to}, bytes from..to of the kit's fixtures/<fixture>) or on_idle with ample weight.

Each step's expectation: result (ok; {"module": i}, DispatchError::Module { index: 90, error: [i, 0, 0, 0] }; bad_origin; funds_unavailable; invalid_payment, InvalidTransaction::Payment in validate, never included; undecodable, the call's bytes refused before dispatch); events, the pallet's Event in SCALE, without the runtime's index; storage, every raw key of the pallet's whose value changed (null: removed); balances, each account's deltas (free, held_registration, held_submit, providers).

fees: false vectors run in the pallet's own mock runtime, no fee pipeline: deposits pinned exactly. fees: true vectors run in Kreivo's runtime with ChargeSpaceFee: free deltas by sign only (+, -, 0; the signer always listed), payer who paid the fee (sovereign or signer), and Budget's writes pinned by key and window, the value's spent masked (each ? a nibble not compared: it sums fees, the teammate's weights). The mock charges every fee at fee_bound.

A call's parts may also be {repeat, count}: the byte repeat (hex) count times. unpinned: raw keys a harness leaves out of every step's storage, items the design lets a pallet keep that the mock does not (PruneCursor, on_idle's cursor).

Balances: in a pallet-level vector every account a step does not list is unchanged; in a fees vector the runtime's fee recipients (the block author, the treasury's share) are not pinned, and only the accounts listed are. A pre-state's consumers exclude the one FRAME's Balances takes for a hold (sovereign F's are 0 though it holds its registration deposit): the teammate's harness keeps its own; providers are pinned as deltas.

Accounts: 'names' labels them. The fixture space F ([0xa1; 32], the fixtures' statements' space) is in every pre-state as storage, since no genesis hashes to its id; space B is registered by call from a genesis of two founders.

vectors.title: register: the fixture genesis's space registered, anchoring from the venue's next window (start_window now_w + 1), its sovereign address `modl ‖ kv/space ‖ space[..20]`, the deposit held; refused: the founder's signature under another controller (BadFounder), a second registration (SpaceExists); a space whose clock has not started registered from window 0

add_authority (with a paired anchor key, and without), remove_authority (its key leaves AnchorKeys), each account's providers; refused: a non-controller (NotController), an unknown space (UnknownSpace), a second removal (NotAuthority)
anchor at w, then w + 2 (a gap), by an authority and by any signed account; Last follows

anchor refusals: before the space's first window (WindowNotAfterLast), older than MaxRootAge (WindowTooOld), exactly MaxRootAge old taken, the same root again (AlreadyAnchored), the open window now_w and a later one (WindowInFuture), then now_ms at B_w and the same anchor resubmitted (Anchored); a stale w ≤ Last (WindowNotAfterLast); a second root at a held window past MaxRootAge (WindowTooOld: no evidence, the space active); a bad signature (BadAnchorSignature), kind 1 (BadKind), an unlisted key (UnknownAnchorKey), an unknown space (UnknownSpace), now_ms before the origin (WindowInFuture)

an equivocation ends a space: a second root of a window held, signed by another listed key (the failover case: the honest node's anchor as the evidence), Equivocated naming both signers and SpaceEnded, the status Ended (index 3), the registration deposit released to the sovereign; then its anchors refused (SpaceNotActive), the evidence's too, and its roots unanchored (a statement over a window held refused 5); the registration replayed refused (SpaceExists: the space is never pruned); dispatch_as_sovereign still the controller's, the sovereign's funds leaving, the existential deposit kept
submit of the masked format-39 fixture: its two roots anchored, then Accepted { id }, Seen[id] its newest root's B_w + MaxRootAge, the deposit held and released

one mutant per refusal class, each Refused { code } and DepositForfeited: 1 (the statement cut short), 2 (format 30), 3 (a program not in Programs), 4 (a space not its roots'), 5 (a root not anchored), 0x1xx (the proof's byte flipped); 6 is G8's, its deposit released. Then the statement itself against activation windows: 2 while Formats[39].until_ms is now (retired), and while its from_ms is past now; 3 while its program's until_ms is now, and while its from_ms is past now; accepted once now reaches it
the same statement twice: Accepted, then Refused { 6 } with the deposit released

a statement of no root refused 4: venues judge rooted statements alone. A rooted one accepted; at MaxRootAge + 1 past its newest root's B_w, resubmitted before on_idle refused 5 (its anchors held but past MaxRootAge); on_idle prunes its Seen entry; resubmitted, refused 5

a submit whose sovereign cannot hold the deposit (InsufficientSovereignBalance, nothing moved); a non-authority's submit (NotAuthority); set_paused by a signed account (BadOrigin); each pause flag, by the emergency origin, refusing its call (Paused): bit 0 submit, bit 1 anchor, bit 2 register, each other call unpaused; cleared by Root

set_program by ProgramsOrigin: from_ms before now + delay, or an until_ms set before it, refused (TooEarly); at now + delay taken; Root at once; a signed account (BadOrigin); a removal by ProgramsOrigin sets until_ms = now + delay, Root's removes at once; a change other than setting or shortening until_ms (an active program's from_ms moved) needs from_ms ≥ now + delay (TooEarly); a handler other than Record does not decode

fees, signs only: a submit whose sovereign cannot cover its fee and deposit refused in validate (InvalidTransaction::Payment), nothing paid; an authority's anchor and submit paid by the sovereign account, the authority unchanged; a non-authority's anchor and submit paid by the signer

the budget, fees: at 8 × (SubmitDeposit + FeeBound) a window, eight forfeiting submits taken and the ninth refused in validate (InvalidTransaction::Payment; OverBudget in the fallback), the sovereign untouched; the next window resets it; set_budget to two submits' worth, the window's second taken and its third refused; set_budget to SubmitDeposit + 2 × FeeBound, the next window's accepted submit, its deposit credited back, leaving room for one forfeiting submit, and the next refused. The model charges each fee at FeeBound, so eight fill the budget exactly

the controller and keys: set_controller (the old controller then NotController); add_authority of an authority already (AuthorityExists: a node's key changes only by replacing the node), of a key paired elsewhere (AnchorKeyInUse), of a key of small order (BadAnchorKey); an unpaired founding key paired; remove_anchor_key of a paired key (AnchorKeyInUse), of an unpaired founding key (removed), of an unlisted one (UnknownAnchorKey); remove_authority with a consumer on the account, its provider kept (best effort)

dispatch_as_sovereign: a transfer from the sovereign (SovereignDispatched); set_status by a signed account (BadOrigin); blocked: its submits and anchors refused (SpaceNotActive), unblocked back to Active; a blocked space's roots unanchored (5); an ended space neither blocked nor unblocked (SpaceNotActive); set_format by ProgramsOrigin under the delay (TooEarly), at now + delay taken, Root at once
on_idle: at B_w + MaxRootAge of F's newest root, only older anchors pruned; one ms later its anchor and the Seen entry pruned; Last, Equivocations and an ended space's record kept

registration refusals: a window length below vos_anchor::MIN_LENGTH_MS or above MAX_LENGTH_MS (BadClock), 17 founding keys, one key twice, a key of small order or a genesis that does not decode (BadGenesis), a key not in the genesis or another founder's signature (BadFounder), a sovereign already listed (SovereignInUse), an unfunded sovereign (InsufficientSovereignBalance), a second registration (SpaceExists); a submit paid by a space other than the statement's: accepted. The length bounds: a genesis of MaxGenesisLen (2,048) bytes decodes (BadGenesis) and one of a byte more does not (undecodable); a statement of MaxStatementLen (65,536) bytes decodes (refused 1) and a byte more does not; a proof of MaxProofLen (262,144) bytes decodes (judged: S, accepted before, a repeat) and a byte more does not
